title: Section 210 BNSS — Cognizance of offences by Magistrates

content.heading: Cognizance of offences by Magistrates
content.text: Section 210 BNSS is the current provision for a Magistrate taking cognizance. Do not treat it as a word-for-word reprint of CrPC section 190. Read the official notified text. Pending inquiries and trials may still be governed by CrPC under BNSS section 531.
